description:
Who We Are Looking For   

 Charles River Development is looking for an experienced API Infrastructure Engineer to join the Cloud Platform Engineering team. In this role, you will design, build, automate, and operate secure enterprise-scale Azure API management platforms. You will help modernize cloud delivery through DevOps practices, reusable IaC modules, automation, and strong operational engineering discipline.   

 Why This Role Is Important to Us   

 The team you will be joining is part of Charles River Development (CRD), which became part of State Street in 2018. CRD develops enterprise investment management software solutions for leading global financial institutions across institutional investment, wealth management, and hedge funds. Together, we created the industry's first open front-to-back platform, State Street Alpha, launched in 2019.   

 Join us if delivering next-generation API management platform , infrastructure, cloud networking, platform automation, deployment reliability, and secure-by-default cloud services using Azure, DevOps, and Infrastructure as Code sounds like a challenge you are ready for.   

 What You Will Be Responsible For   

 As an API Engineer you will be responsible for design ing , develop ing , secur ing , deploy ing , and manag ing enterprise-grade APIs on the Microsoft Azure platform. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in enterprise grade API management solution s , RESTful APIs, cloud-native development, security, automation, and integration patterns. This role works closely with application teams, architects, security teams, and DevOps engineers to deliver scalable and secure API solutions.   

 What We Value   

 API Design and Operations   

 Design, deploy, maintain and automate enterprise API management platform and infrastructure.   

 
 Strong experience with API gateways and service mesh concepts .   

 
 Implement API versioning, lifecycle management, and governance standards.   

 
 Troubleshoot and optimize API performance, reliability, and scalability.   

 
 Familiarity with API specifications using OpenAPI /Swagger standards.   

 
 Expertise in REST APIs; experience with gRPC and event‑driven APIs a plus .   

 
 Develop and maintain API management policies for:    

 
 Authentication and authorization   

 
 Rate limiting and throttling   

 
 Request/response transformations   

 
 Caching   

 

 Header manipulation   

 
 IP filtering   

 
   

 Security and Compliance   

 Implement OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT validation, and certificate-based authentication.   

 
 Integrate APIs with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD).   

 
 Perform API security assessments and vulnerability remediation.   

 
 Ensure compliance with organizational security standards and governance requirements.   

 
 Implement Zero Trust and least privileged access controls.   

 
   

 Automation and DevOps   

 Implement CI/CD pipelines using: Azure DevOps , GitHub Actions , ARM Templates , Bicep , Terraform   

 
 Automate API deployment, configuration, testing, and policy management.   

 
 Manage infrastructure as code ( IaC ) for API platforms.   

 
   

 Monitoring and Operations   

 Monitor API health and performance    

 
 Develop dashboards, alerts, and automated reporting.   

 
 Support production incidents and root cause analysis activities.   

 
   


 Integration and Services   

 Integrate APIs with:    

 
 Azure Entra ID   

 
 Azure Functions   

 
 Azure App Service   

 
 Azure Service Bus   

 
 Azure Event Grid   

 
 Azure Storage   

 
 Azure Key Vault   

 
 Cloud / Gateway Service s   

 
 Azure API Management is big plus.    

 
 Azure Application Gateway   

 
 Ambassador Gateway   

 
 Education & Preferred Qualifications   

 Bachelor’s degree in computer science , Information Technology, Engineering, or related field .   

 
 10+ years of A PI e ngineering / cloud development experience    

 
 Azure certifications such as Azure Developer Associate, Azure Administrator Associate , Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or Azure Security Engineer Associate are preferred.   

 
 Experience with financial services, regulated environments, change management, security audit processes, or large-scale enterprise cloud platforms is a plus.   

 
 Additional Requirements   

 Comfortable working in a global, distributed engineering environment.   

 

 Self-motivated, accountable, delivery-focused, and able to drive technical initiatives independently.   

 
 Passionate about automation, cloud engineering, operational excellence, secure infrastructure, and continuous improvement.   

 
 Ability to document engineering decisions clearly and contribute to team knowledge sharing and collaboration.   

 

 
 Salary Range: 
$90,000 - $157,500 Annual 
 The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ. 
 
 Employees are eligible to participate in State Street’s comprehensive benefits program, which includes: our retirement savings plan (401K) with company match; insurance coverage including basic life, medical, dental, vision, long-term disability, and other optional additional coverages; paid-time off including vacation, sick leave, short term disability, and family care responsibilities; access to our Employee Assistance Program; incentive compensation including eligibility for annual performance-based awards (excluding certain sales roles subject to sales incentive plans); and, eligibility for certain tax advantaged savings plans. 
 For a full overview, visit https://hrportal.ehr.com/statestreet/Home . 
 
 About State Street 
 
 Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
 
 We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.
 
 As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.
 
 Discover more information on jobs at StateStreet.com/careers
